open_points.subject: execute_function_element
open_points.text: - execute_function_element: [RETURN_SHAPE] Returns FunctionElementOutcome with the NodeExecutionDraft, ended_at taken when the outcome is built, and the StoredValues and SpooledFiles of its outputs, each of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the classes of every input value and file the element received — an input file list counting with its SpooledFilesRef's disclosure_class, even when empty — and each output SpooledFilesRef with that same class, so no output is of a lower class than an input.
open_points.other_text: - FunctionElementOutcome fields (exact, no others exist): execution: NodeExecutionDraft, stored_values: tuple[StoredValue, ...], spooled_files: tuple[SpooledFile, ...]
open_points.question: Must ended_at be added to FunctionElementOutcome, or must the return-shape note state explicitly that ended_at is the NodeExecutionDraft's ended_at rather than a FunctionElementOutcome field?
